event: Water dripping sound from a Keurig coffee machine brewing.

sounding_object.description: A black Keurig single-serve coffee maker, K-Classic model or similar. It is roughly 13 inches tall, 10 inches wide, and 13 inches deep. It is located on the kitchen countertop.

reference_object.description: A rectangular wooden dining table with a dark wood top and lighter colored legs/base. It is accompanied by upholstered dining chairs.

facing_object.description: A stainless steel double wall oven, built into the kitchen cabinetry to the right of a large stainless steel refrigerator.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the wooden dining table and facing the stainless steel double wall oven, when the water dripping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
